rules.scope: suppress a weak required-field obligation when every query-grounded token is a schema-shared head immediately following a stronger complete field mention that contains the same head
rules.rationale: In phrases such as customer segment groups, the trailing generic head labels the explicitly named grouping field and is not independent evidence for every schema field sharing that head.
rules.failure_condition: A trailing generic group/category/type/class/segment token promotes unrelated fields that only share the suffix.
rules.conflict_policy: Any explicit, semantic, alias, value, or non-adjacent independent mention preserves the obligation; candidates remain in the audit contract.

rules.scope: promote field-unowned rank/order/sort directives only after measure-dimension closure and remove generic comparison from the emitted task candidate set while retaining the alternative hypothesis in the audit graph
rules.rationale: Ranking is a specific analytical goal that entails comparison; emitting both as peer predictions harms typed task precision and obscures the primary intent.
rules.failure_condition: An explicit order or sort request falls back to comparison, or an explicit rank request emits generic comparison as a peer task.
rules.conflict_policy: Directive spans owned by field mentions are excluded; order/sort require an aggregation and a following by-clause; missing structural roles forbid promotion.

rules.scope: retain one highest-scoring deterministic representative for candidates equivalent under common chart family, field set, encoding-role groups, aggregation, binning, time unit, and typed transforms
rules.rationale: Native chart labels and x/y orientation variants can encode the same common visualization plan; top-k must contain distinct decisions rather than nomenclature variants.
rules.failure_condition: The candidate list contains multiple entries that normalize to the same common plan signature.
rules.conflict_policy: Differences in fields, channel-role groups, aggregates, binning, temporal units, filters, or typed transforms preserve both candidates; ties use the native deterministic signature.

rules.scope: restore a physically numeric field to quantitative when a typed aggregate explicitly targets it and no value-shape temporal profile exists
rules.rationale: Lexical tokens such as time can denote a duration measure; explicit aggregate-role evidence is stronger than a field-name temporal hint.
rules.failure_condition: A numeric duration such as handling_time is converted into a temporal dimension despite being the explicit target of mean, sum, or median.
rules.conflict_policy: Value-shape temporal evidence or an existing temporal summary prevents restoration; min/max temporal extrema are left unchanged.
